NOVELTY.concern: Delineation of unique contribution beyond combining established tools
NOVELTY.rule: Must explicitly acknowledge known primitives and isolate cyber-physical invariants/proofs

EXPERIMENTAL_BREADTH.concern: Environmental and hardware diversity vs narrow benchmark/simulation
EXPERIMENTAL_BREADTH.rule: Must explicitly differentiate simulation/staged drills from unconstrained live deployment

LANGUAGE.concern: Technical precision and removal of promotional superlatives
LANGUAGE.rule: Prohibit marketing adjectives; ensure consistent terminology and balanced capitalization

LIMITATIONS.concern: Comprehensive boundary disclosure (scalability, noise, sync, thermal, complexity)
LIMITATIONS.rule: Must dedicate comprehensive section detailing edge failure modes and theoretical bounds
